# TreasuryPilot: API Specification (v1)

**Status:** Draft for gate G2 · **Style:** REST + JSON, OpenAPI 3.1 generated by FastAPI (ADR-010)
**Base URL:** `/v1` · **Auth:** session cookie (`tp_session`) + `X-CSRF-Token` on mutations (ADR-009)

## 0. Common conventions

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Tenancy | Org-scoped routes start with `/v1/orgs/{orgId}`. The user must be a member; otherwise 404 (no existence leak). |
| Permissions | Listed per endpoint by role: `OWN` Owner, `APR` Approver, `OPR` Operator, `FIN` Finance, `GRD` Guardian, `ADM` OrgAdmin, `AUD` Auditor, `ANY` any member. |
| Amounts | Decimal **strings** in base units, e.g. `"25000000"` (ADR-014). |
| Addresses | 0x-checksummed strings. |
| Idempotency | `Idempotency-Key` header **required** on POSTs marked 🔁. Repeating a call with the same key returns the original response. |
| Pagination | `?cursor=&limit=` → `{items, nextCursor}`. |
| Errors | RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`: `{type, title, status, code, detail, instance, errors?, fields?}`. `code` values are stable (see §9). |
| Concurrency | Mutable resources return `ETag`/`version`. Updates need `If-Match`, otherwise `412`. |

## 1. Identity & organizations (M01)

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Perm | Request → Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/magic-link` | Send a login link | public (rate-limited) | `{email}` → `202` | 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| POST | `/auth/magic-link/verify` | Exchange the token for a session | public | `{token}` → `200 {user, csrfToken}` + Set-Cookie | 400 `TOKEN_INVALID`, 410 `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, 429 `RATE_LIMITED` |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | End the session | auth | → `204` | |
| GET | `/me` | Current user, memberships, linked wallets | auth | → `{user, memberships[], wallets[]}` | |
| GET | `/auth/siwe/nonce` | Get a SIWE nonce | auth | → `{nonce, expiresAt}` | |
| POST | `/me/wallets` | Link a wallet via SIWE | auth | `{message, signature}` → `201 {address}` | 400 `SIWE_INVALID`, 409 `ADDRESS_LINKED_ELSEWHERE` |
| DELETE | `/me/wallets/{address}` | Unlink a wallet | auth | → `204` | 409 `SIGNER_ROLE_REQUIRES_WALLET` |
| POST | `/orgs` | Create an org (caller → OrgAdmin) | auth | `{name, legalName?, country?, displayTz?}` → `201 {org}` | |
| GET | `/orgs/{orgId}` | Org details and onboarding checklist | ANY | → `{org, checklist:{memberCount, walletLinked, treasuryCreated, moduleEnabled}}` | |
| PATCH | `/orgs/{orgId}/settings` | Solo mode, auto-match, etc. | ADM (solo mode: OWN) | `{soloMode?, autoMatch?}` → `{org}` | 403 |
| GET | `/orgs/{orgId}/members` | List members | ANY | → `{items}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/invites` | Invite a member | ADM | `{email, roles[]}` → `201 {invite}` | 409 `ALREADY_MEMBER` |
| POST | `/invites/{token}/accept` | Accept an invite | auth | → `{membership}` | 410 `INVITE_EXPIRED` |
| PATCH | `/orgs/{orgId}/members/{userId}` | Change roles | ADM | `{roles[]}` → `{membership}` | 409 `LAST_ADMIN`, `LAST_OWNER` |
| DELETE | `/orgs/{orgId}/members/{userId}` | Remove a member | ADM | → `204` | 409 `LAST_ADMIN` |

## 2. Treasury & chain (M02)

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Perm | Request → Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/chains` | Supported chains and assets | auth | → `{chains[{chainId, assets[]}]}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries` | Create a treasury | OWN, ADM | `{chainId, assetId, wallets[{role, safeAddress, label}]}` → `201 {treasury}` | 422 `NOT_A_SAFE`, `WRONG_CHAIN`, `DUPLICATE_WALLET`, `UNSUPPORTED_ASSET` |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/safes/deploy-tx` | Build a Safe deployment transaction | OWN, ADM | `{chainId, owners[], threshold}` → `{chainId, transaction:{to,data,value}}`; submitted by the connected wallet | 422 `INVALID_SAFE_CONFIGURATION`; 503 `SAFE_DEPLOYMENT_UNAVAILABLE`, `RPC_UNAVAILABLE` |
| GET | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries` | List the organization's treasuries for the consolidated view | ANY | → `{items[{id, chainId, chainName, assetId, assetSymbol, assetDecimals, assetIsTest, status, coverage, createdAt}]}` | One row per treasury; no amount or counter aggregation across assets; `assetDecimals`/`assetIsTest` are null when the asset is missing from the startup configuration |
| GET | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}` | Treasury state (balances, coverage, mandate, today's budget) | ANY | → `{treasury, wallets[], coverage, mandate, budgets, staleness}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}/module/deploy-tx` | Build module deployment and enablement Safe transactions | OWN | `{mandate, buffers}` → `{governanceTx, operationalGovernanceTxs[], predictedModuleAddress}` | 503 `MODULE_DEPLOYMENT_UNAVAILABLE`, `RPC_UNAVAILABLE`; 409 if setup is already open |

`mandate` supplies `validFrom`, `expiresAt`, `payeeCoolingSeconds`, `executor`, optional `guardian`, `pay`, `refill`, and `supply` limits (`perRequest` and `daily` as integer base-unit strings), `approvalMaxAge`, and `approvers`. `buffers` must contain exactly one `{wallet, minimum, target}` entry for T and every operational Safe. The endpoint returns separate Safe transactions because each Safe must authorize its own `enableModule` call.
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}/coverage/refresh` | Re-read Safe configs | OWN, ADM | → `{coverage, details}` | 503 `RPC_UNAVAILABLE` |
| POST | `/orgs/{orgId}/treasuries/{tId}/coverage/acknowledge` | Accept PARTIAL coverage | OWN | `{reason}` → `{coverage}` | 409 `COVERAGE_COMPLETE` |

## 3. Mandate, payees, exceptions, pause (M03)

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Perm | Request → Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/mandates` | Version history | ANY | → `{items}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/mandates` | Create a draft and preview its Safe bundle | OWN | `MandateConfig` → `201 {draft, summary, diff, requiresConfirmation, bundlePreview}` | 422 `MANDATE_INCOMPLETE`, `TARGET_BELOW_BUFFER`, `MIN_SUPPLY_ABOVE_LIMIT`, … |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/mandates/{v}/clone` | Clone a compatible version into a new draft | OWN | → `201 {draft, summary, diff, requiresConfirmation, bundlePreview}` | 404, 409 `MANDATE_CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED` |
| DELETE | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/mandates/{v}` | Discard a draft version | OWN | → `204` | 404, 409 `NOT_DRAFT` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/mandates/{v}/activation-tx` | Build the Safe tx for `configureMandate` | OWN | → `{safeTx}` | 409 `NOT_DRAFT` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/mandates/{v}/activation` 🔁 | Report the submitted tx hash; the system tracks it until Active | OWN | `{txHash}` → `202 {status: PendingActivation}` | |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/payees` | List payees | ANY | → `{items[{status, activeFrom, screening}]}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/payees` | Propose or add a payee (runs screening) | OPR, ADM, OWN | `{vendorId, label, address}` → `201 {payee: Screening}` | 409 `PAYEE_EXISTS`, 422 `SCREENING_HIT` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/payees/{id}/registration-tx` | Build the Safe tx `addPayee` (cooling starts on-chain) | OWN | → `{safeTx}` | 409 `SCREENING_NOT_CLEAR` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/payees/{id}/deactivation-tx` | Build the deactivation tx | OWN | → `{safeTx}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/pause` 🔁 | Backend pause now + sentinel on-chain pause (or Guardian-Safe tx for a human) | OWN, GRD | `{reason}` → `{backendPaused: true, onchain, sentinelTxHash?, guardianSafeTx?}` | |
| | Governance txs, signatures, fee policy, payee OOB verification, revoke | see docs/modules/mandate §6 | | | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/treasuries/{t}/resume-tx` | Build the resume tx | OWN | → `{safeTx}` | 403 for GRD |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/exception` | Exception request (AI draft + numbers) | OWN, OPR, FIN | → `{exception, numbers, aiDraft?}` | 404 |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/exception/grant-tx` | Build the `grantException` governance tx (M04-D3; signed in-app, M03-D1) | OWN | `{expiryHours?}` → `{governanceTx}` | 409 `DAILY_LIMIT_WOULD_EXCEED`, `NOT_OVER_CAP`, `PAYEE_NOT_ACTIVE` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/exception/reject` | Reject | OWN | `{reason}` → `{exception: Rejected}` | |

**`MandateConfig` (request body)**
```json
{
  "actions": ["REFILL", "PAY", "SUPPLY"],
  "refillPaths": [{"from": "<T>", "to": "<O1>"}, {"from": "<T>", "to": "<O2>"}],
  "limits": {
    "PAY":    {"perRequest": "2000000000", "daily": "10000000000"},
    "REFILL": {"perRequest": "2500000000", "daily": "12000000000"}
  },
  "supplyLimits": {"perRequest": "5000000000", "daily": "20000000000"},
  "buffers": [
    {"wallet": "<T>", "minimum": "1000000000"},
    {"wallet": "<O1>", "minimum": "10000000", "target": "150000000"}
  ],
  "minSupply": "500000000",
  "reserveHorizonDays": 30,
  "gasFundingCapWei": "50000000000000000",
  "swap": null,
  "executor": "0xExecutor…",
  "approvers": ["0xApprover…"],
  "guardian": "0xGuardian…",
  "validFrom": "2026-10-15T00:00:00Z",
  "expiresAt": "2026-11-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```

## 4. Invoices & requests (M05, M09 intake)

| Method | Endpoint | Purpose | Perm | Request → Response | Errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests` 🔁 | Manual draft | OPR, ADM | `RequestInput` → `201 {request, flags[]}` | 422 `ASSET_NOT_PAYMENT_STABLECOIN`, `PAYEE_UNKNOWN`, `AMOUNT_PRECISION` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/upload` 🔁 | Upload PDF/image → extraction job | OPR | multipart `file` → `202 {requestId, extractionJobId}` | 413 `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, 415 `UNSUPPORTED_TYPE` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/import-csv` 🔁 | CSV import | OPR | multipart → `{created[], errors[]}` | 422 `CSV_HEADER_INVALID` |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/requests` | List or filter | ANY | `?status=&dueBefore=&treasuryId=` → `{items}` | |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}` | Detail with revisions, flags, extraction provenance, approvals, timeline | ANY | → `RequestDetail` | |
| PATCH | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}` | Edit a draft (new revision; invalidates approvals) | OPR | `If-Match` + fields → `{request}` | 409 `NOT_EDITABLE`, 412 |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/terms/confirm` | Confirm the extracted terms | OPR | `{terms}` → `{request}` | 422 `TERMS_INVALID` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/submit` | Draft → AwaitingApproval | OPR | → `{request}` | 409 `DUPLICATE_FINGERPRINT`, `TERMS_UNCONFIRMED` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/flags/{fId}/ack` | Acknowledge a flag | APR | `{note}` → `{flag}` | |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/approval-typed-data` | EIP-712 `PaymentApproval` to sign | APR | → `{domain, types, message}` | 409 `MAKER_CHECKER`, `HIGH_FLAGS_UNACKED` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/approve` 🔁 | Submit the approval signature | APR | `{signature, revision, expiry}` (`expiry` = `message.expiry` that was signed; `revision` = `X-Request-Revision` of the typed-data response) → `{request: Approved}` | 400 `SIGNATURE_INVALID`, `APPROVAL_EXPIRY_INVALID`, 403 `NOT_IN_APPROVER_SET`, 409 `MAKER_CHECKER`, `REVISION_CHANGED` |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/reject` | Reject | APR | `{reason}` → `{request: Rejected}` | |
| POST | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/cancel` | Cancel | OPR, OWN | `{reason}` → `{request: Cancelled, cancelOnchain}` | 409 `PAYMENT_IN_FLIGHT` |
| GET | `/orgs/{o}/requests/{rId}/cancel-tx` | On-chain `cancelRequest` tx (approver wallet or Safe tx) | APR, OWN | → `{to, data}` / `{safeTx}` | 409 `CANCEL_NOT_NEEDED` |
| | Vendors, withdraw, request-changes, extraction/confirm, renew | see docs/modules/invoices §6 | | | |

## 9. Error codes (stable)

These map 1:1 to validator reason codes where applicable, so the UI and the contract revert reasons line up.

| Code | Meaning | BR |
|---|---|---|
| `NOT_APPROVED`, `APPROVAL_INVALID`, `APPROVAL_EXPIRED`, `NOT_IN_APPROVER_SET` | Approval issues | BR-001, BR-003, BR-004 |
| `MAKER_CHECKER` | Creator or editor approving | BR-005 |
| `PAYEE_UNKNOWN`, `PAYEE_COOLING`, `SCREENING_HIT` | Payee issues | BR-013, BR-017, BR-085 |
| `OVER_PER_REQUEST_LIMIT` (→ NEEDS_APPROVAL), `OVER_DAILY_LIMIT` | Limits | BR-022, BR-040 |
| `BUFFER_BREACH`, `SOURCE_INSUFFICIENT` | Liquidity | BR-030, BR-033 |
| `DUPLICATE_FINGERPRINT`, `REQUEST_ALREADY_PAID`, `STEP_ALREADY_EXECUTED` | Replay | BR-061, BR-071 |
| `MANDATE_PAUSED`, `MANDATE_EXPIRED`, `MANDATE_NOT_ACTIVE` | Lifecycle | BR-015, BR-062 |
| `COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE`, `SNAPSHOT_STALE`, `UNKNOWN_OPERATION_PENDING` | Safety gates | BR-018, BR-051, BR-060 |
| `AI_PLAN_REJECTED`, `AI_UNAVAILABLE` | AI path | BR-055, BR-056 |
| `ATTESTATION_INVALID`, `PAYLOAD_MISMATCH` | Signer | BR-059 |
| `ATTESTATION_EXPIRED`, `NONCE_REUSED` | Signer | BR-059 |
| `FLAG_UNACKNOWLEDGED`, `APPROVAL_STALE`, `EXCEPTION_INVALID`, `NOT_OPERATIONAL_WALLET`, `WRONG_REFILL_TARGET`, `ALREADY_REFILLED_FOR_REQUEST`, `OVER_REFILL_PER_REQUEST`, `OVER_REFILL_DAILY`, `SOURCE_BUFFER_BREACH`, `REFILL_EXCEEDS_NEED`, `REFILL_BOUND`, `PAUSE_REQUESTED`, `CIRCUIT_OPEN`, `DATA_MISSING`, `CHAIN_MISMATCH`, `ASSET_MISMATCH`, `EXECUTOR_MISMATCH`, `MANDATE_REVOKED`, `PLAN_MALFORMED`, `SIMULATION_REVERTED`, `SIMULATION_UNAVAILABLE`, `OVER_SUPPLY_PER_TX`, `OVER_SUPPLY_DAILY`, `SUPPLY_FLOOR_BREACH`, `RESERVE_BREACH`, `INSUFFICIENT_POOL_LIQUIDITY`, `INSUFFICIENT_A_TOKEN`, `BORROW_NOT_AUTHORIZED`, `HEALTH_FACTOR_TOO_LOW`, `WRONG_PAYMENT_OPTION`, `TRANSFER_FAILED`, `BALANCE_DELTA_MISMATCH`, `ALLOWANCE_NOT_CLEARED`, `REQUEST_CANCELLED` | Added in M08; full catalogue with decisions and contract errors in docs/modules/policy-engine §6.4 | |
| Warnings: `DEADLINE_MISSED`, `DISCOUNT_MISSED`, `TARGET_NOT_REACHED`, `BELOW_MIN_SUPPLY` | Never change the decision | M08-D7 |
